cohort: This study included 67 pregnant women with preeclampsia and 67 pregnant women without preeclampsia at secondary referral government hospitals in East Java, Indonesia.
finding: Pregnant women with a familial history of preeclampsia were significantly more likely to develop preeclampsia themselves.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was more common in the preeclampsia group compared to the control group (59.7% vs 40.3%, p = 0.025).
